result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: restaurant names truncated in the Fastest near you carousel and incomplete delivery/meta text under the second popular card.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' section, the third restaurant name is cut off mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of showing the full name.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or truncate with an ellipsis so the full name remains readable or clearly indicated.

issues.description: The second Popular card (pizza) has no visible restaurant name or delivery/time metadata below the image, unlike the ramen card above it—only the image with -20% badge is shown before the nav bar.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent title and meta row under each popular card, or ensure vertical spacing so labels are not pushed off-screen unexpectedly.
